Figure 5:Capability matrix over the 15 solo models, six axes. Each column
rank-normalizes one behavioral metric averaged over the three seeds
(1 = best of 15; construction in Appendix15), and rows are
sorted by mean final score. The winner is a generalist, with no axis below 0.79
and mean 0.94, rather than the leader of any single one; the mid-table pairs

on most axes at once.
